bonifaciocitadel.name: Bonifacio Citadel
bonifaciocitadel.slogan: A town balanced on a limestone cliff, staring at Sardinia.
bonifaciocitadel.line: Founded as a fortress in 828 by Boniface II of Tuscany, it gave the town its name.

calanchesdepiana.name: Calanques de Piana
calanchesdepiana.slogan: Red granite that glows like embers over the Gulf of Porto.
calanchesdepiana.line: Together with the Gulf of Porto and Scandola, they have been UNESCO World Heritage since 1983.

ajaccioboncasa.name: Maison Bonaparte
ajaccioboncasa.slogan: The modest rooms where an emperor first cried.
ajaccioboncasa.line: Napoleon was born here in 1769; the Bonapartes owned the house almost continuously from 1682 to 1923.

calvicitadel.name: Calvi Citadel
calvicitadel.slogan: A Genoese fortress over the bay, and a town that claims Columbus.
calvicitadel.line: Calvi's plaque says Christopher Columbus was born here, though most historians say Genoa.

cortecitadel.name: Corte Citadel
cortecitadel.slogan: An eagle's nest above the rivers, where Corsica ran itself.
cortecitadel.line: Pasquale Paoli made Corte the capital of independent Corsica from 1755 to 1769.
